title: Shade that travels with you
odia:
ଛାଇତ ତ ଛାଇ, ଛତାର ଛାଇ
ଗଛ ଛାଇ କି ସଙ୍ଗତେ ଯାଇ?
literal_meaning: Shade indeed, shade—the umbrella’s shade. Does a tree’s shade go along with you?
meaning_odia: ଛତାର ଛାଇ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଯାଇପାରେ, ଗଛର ଛାଇ କି ସେପରି ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ଯିବ—କଥାଟି ଏହି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରୁଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଏକ ଜାଗାରେ ମିଳୁଥିବା ସୁବିଧା ଓ ଚାଲିବା ବେଳେ ସାଙ୍ଗରେ ନେଇହେଉଥିବା ସୁବିଧାର ତଫାତ ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ। କେବଳ ଛାଇ ଥିଲେ ନୁହେଁ, ଯେଉଁଠି ଦରକାର ସେଠି ତାହା ମିଳିବାର କଥା।
explanation: Both the umbrella and the tree offer shade, but the question asks which can accompany someone who moves. Our editorial reading values help that remains available where it is needed. The contrast is about portability and circumstance, not a claim that stationary shelter has no worth.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Someone can use an essential reference only in one office but needs it while travelling. A colleague compares a copy they can carry with the umbrella’s shade that goes along with them.
cultural_context: The first line repeats ଛାଇ, making the shared benefit clear. The second introduces ସଙ୍ଗତେ ଯାଇ—going along—and makes that the deciding difference.
